finalText:
All 40 tests pass now.

**Root cause:** `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` rounded to 2 decimal places twice in USD (once after the percent coupon, once after the flat coupon) before converting to the order's currency and rounding a third time. Truncating fractional cents in USD before applying a non-1 exchange rate discards precision that should have rounded up in the target currency — so it only shows up when a percent coupon leaves a fractional-cent remainder *and* the order isn't USD (GBP, CAD, JPY in this case), which is why most carts looked fine.

**Fix:** removed the two intermediate `round()` calls so the discount math stays in full precision through conversion, and only rounds once at the end in the target currency's own decimal places — matching how a finance ledger should compute it.
